caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative ceramic dog figurine sitting upright on a black base. The dog’s body and face are primarily painted in shades of gray and light brown, with sculpted fur details accentuated by darker shading. Its long, drooping ears and the tip of its tail are colored reddish-brown. The dog’s eyes are round with black pupils and a yellow iris, and its nose and mouth are outlined in black and red. Around its neck is a dark collar with a gold tag or medallion hanging from it. On the body, there are two decorative circular patterns on each side, incorporating green and red colors. The drawing is centered on a beige background outlined with a double border, and the artist’s signature, “MINA LOWRY,” appears in the lower left corner.
title: Pa. German Prince Charles Spaniel
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
